pipeline_metadata.note: Phase 2 automated pipeline replaces Phase 1 manual curation. Trust signals computed from first-party review and complaint data. Per ImplementationPlan.md, a manual QA round of 200+ classifications is required before user-facing deployment.

pharmacy_health.caveat: Pharmacy adoption barriers may include medical trust beyond peer evidence. Per EdgeCases.md, trial-rate lift may be lower than electronics. Phase 2 will produce signal on this.
